written.myAnswer: During G1, the cell grows, synthesizes proteins and organelles, and produces enzymes needed for DNA replication in S phase.
The main purpose of S phase is to replicate the DNA of each chromosome. Each chromosome is duplicated, while the total chromosome number remains unchanged.
Skin cells divide to replace cells that are lost or damaged. Nerve and muscle cells become highly specialized and generally leave the cell cycle, remaining in G0 rather than continuing to divide.
